detail.title: The Album Generator

projects.name: SyBorg
projects.stack: Xenochronic Clocks, Lydian Vamps, Synth Leads

detail.title: SyBorg (The Zappa Instant Composition Engine)
detail.subtitle: A Tunable Module Generating Real-Time Chromatic Guitar Solos Over Metric-Divergent Backing Vamps
detail.description: SyBorg (referencing the infamous, government-sanctioned robotic companion from *Joe's Garage*) is our dedicated Frank Zappa-style guitar solo generator. It doesn't play pre-recorded riffs—it uses cybernetic Xenochrony and irrational metric subdivisions to physically "sculpt" a lead melody in real-time on top of a steady, looping backing band.

projects.name: The Central Scrutinizer
projects.stack: Local Quantized LLM, TTS, Semantic Patching

detail.title: The Central Scrutinizer
detail.subtitle: A Local, Low-Overhead Quantized LLM Modulator Driving Improvisational Patch Routings & Satirical Vocal Synthesis
detail.description: The Central Scrutinizer is a discovery project investigating how a tiny, quantized local LLM (typically a 1-Billion to 3-Billion parameter model, such as *Qwen-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF* or *Llama-3-1B* running offline on your local CPU) can inject high-level, organic, and non-repetitive creativity into our generated music stream.
